name: spotify-control
description: Control the Spotify desktop app from Claude Code on macOS: now playing, play/pause/next/previous, play a Spotify link or search for a track. Fixed osascript scripts only, no daemon, no state file.

spotify_client_id.title: Spotify client ID
spotify_client_id.description: From a free app at developer.spotify.com/dashboard; only needed for search

spotify_client_secret.title: Spotify client secret
spotify_client_secret.description: The secret of the same Spotify app; kept in secure storage and only ever sent to Spotify
